title: Write something on the patient's record
summary: The patient's internal notes (not clinical): preferences, notices for the front desk.

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; tapping one opens their record on the right.

steps.title: Open their record
steps.details: Tap the patient in the list. The guide continues once their record is open.

steps.title: Notes
steps.details: Internal free text; the team sees it, not the patient.

steps.title: Save
steps.details: Saves the note. Cancel discards what you wrote.
